grand-hirafu.hours: About 8:30–16:30; night skiing on selected lifts
grand-hirafu.character: Village skiing, long fall line, mixed ability. Core of Niseko United.
grand-hirafu.access: Typical winter drive from New Chitose Airport is about 2 hr 10 min. Direct airport buses run to Hirafu, Village, and Annupuri. Check the official getting-here page for the current timetable.

hanazono.character: Quieter Niseko United side; trees and family terrain.
hanazono.access: Typical winter drive from New Chitose Airport is about 2 hr 10 min. Direct airport buses run to Hirafu, Village, and Annupuri. Check the official getting-here page for the current timetable.

niseko-village.hours: About 8:30–16:30; night skiing on selected lifts
niseko-village.character: Gondola-served United terrain above the Hilton/Green Leaf base.
niseko-village.access: Typical winter drive from New Chitose Airport is about 2 hr 10 min. Direct airport buses run to Hirafu, Village, and Annupuri. Check the official getting-here page for the current timetable.

annupuri.character: Mellow pitch, good in a storm; links to Village and Moiwa.
annupuri.access: Typical winter drive from New Chitose Airport is about 2 hr 10 min. Direct airport buses run to Hirafu, Village, and Annupuri. Check the official getting-here page for the current timetable.

moiwa.character: Small independent hill next to Annupuri. Not on the Niseko United pass.
moiwa.access: About 20 min from Hirafu by car. No United shuttle requirement — drive or taxi from Niseko Village / Annupuri.

rusutsu.hours: About 8:30–16:00; night skiing on the East side
rusutsu.character: Three peaks, long cruising trails, family and park terrain.
rusutsu.access: About 1 hr 45 min from New Chitose by car. Direct airport buses in winter. About 40 min from Niseko.

kiroro.character: Deep snow, two faces (Asari and Nagamine), quieter than Niseko.
kiroro.access: About 1 hr 35 min from New Chitose, about 55 min from central Sapporo. Closest big mountain to Otaru.

sapporo-teine.hours: Day plus well-known night skiing (check official hours)
sapporo-teine.character: City mountain: steep World Cup pitches and easy lower slopes.
sapporo-teine.access: About 30 min from Sapporo Station, about 1 hr from New Chitose. City bus and car.

sapporo-kokusai.character: Snowy Jozankei-side hill; trees and storm skiing close to Sapporo.
sapporo-kokusai.access: About 50 min from central Sapporo, about 1 hr 15 min from New Chitose. Car or bus via Jozankei.

asarigawa-onsen.hours: Day and night sessions (check official hours)
asarigawa-onsen.character: Small Otaru hill with onsen at the base. Easy day trip from Sapporo.
asarigawa-onsen.access: About 40 min from Sapporo, 18 min from Otaru. Car is simplest in winter.

furano.hours: About 8:30–16:00; limited night skiing in season
furano.character: Two faces (Furano and Kitanomine), long groomers, inland powder.
furano.access: About 1 hr from Asahikawa Airport, 2 hr 30 min from New Chitose. Winter buses from both airports.

tomamu.character: Self-contained resort village, UNKAI Gondola, family facilities.
tomamu.access: About 1 hr 50 min from New Chitose via the expressway. JR to Tomamu Station plus resort shuttle.

kamui-ski-links.character: Asahikawa powder hill with a gondola; quieter than Furano.
kamui-ski-links.access: About 25 min from Asahikawa city, 35 min from Asahikawa Airport. Car is the usual winter option.

asahidake.character: One ropeway, onsen village, backcountry focus — not a groomed mega-resort.
asahidake.access: About 1 hr from Asahikawa Airport via Higashikawa. Car or limited winter bus.

sahoro.character: Quiet eastern hill, Club Med on site, good for families.
sahoro.access: About 2 hr 15 min from New Chitose. 15 min from Shintoku; 40 min from Tomamu.

appi-kogen.character: Big Iwate resort village with a gondola and long groomers.
appi-kogen.access: About 55 min from Morioka. Shinkansen to Morioka plus bus, or drive from Sendai Airport (~2.5 hr).

zao-onsen.hours: Day plus night skiing on lower slopes (check official hours)
zao-onsen.character: Onsen town skiing and the famous ice trees (juhyo) in mid-winter.
zao-onsen.access: About 40 min from Yamagata city, about 1 hr from Sendai Airport. Bus from Yamagata Station.

alts-bandai.character: Open Bandai-side terrain; easy day from Aizu / Inawashiro.
alts-bandai.access: About 1.5 hr from Sendai. Closest station Inawashiro plus bus or taxi.

geto-kogen.character: Steep, snowy Kitakami hill known for powder and fewer crowds.
geto-kogen.access: About 40 min from Kitakami (Tohoku Shinkansen). Car or winter bus.

gala-yuzawa.character: Ski-in from Gala Yuzawa Station. Beginner-friendly Tokyo day trip.
gala-yuzawa.access: Joetsu Shinkansen to Gala Yuzawa Station (about 80 min from Tokyo). Walk from the platform to the gondola.

kagura.character: Tashiro–Mitsumata–Kagura: long season, powder, and the Dragondola to Naeba.
kagura.access: Shinkansen to Echigo-Yuzawa plus bus (~30 min). Linked to Naeba by Dragondola.

naeba.character: Prince resort village, Dragondola link to Kagura, mixed-ability trails.
naeba.access: Shinkansen to Echigo-Yuzawa plus bus (~40 min). Direct winter buses from Tokyo.

ishiuchi-maruyama.hours: Day plus night skiing (check official hours)
ishiuchi-maruyama.character: Large Yuzawa-area hill with a gondola and a night-skiing scene.
ishiuchi-maruyama.access: Shinkansen to Echigo-Yuzawa plus bus (~15 min). Linked toward Gala / Yuzawa Kogen.

maiko.hours: Day plus night skiing (check official hours)
maiko.character: Family-oriented Minamiuonuma hill close to the Yuzawa corridor.
maiko.access: Shinkansen to Echigo-Yuzawa plus bus (~20 min).

happo-one.character: Hakuba’s flagship: World Cup pitch, long fall line, and village nightlife.
happo-one.access: Shinkansen to Nagano plus express bus (~1 hr). About 8 min from Hakuba Station by bus.

hakuba-47.character: Linked 47 and Goryu: trees, park, and a gondola above the valley.
hakuba-47.access: Same Hakuba bus corridor as Happo. About 10 min from Happo by car or valley shuttle.

tsugaike.character: Wide beginner-friendly plateau plus a ropeway toward the alpine.
tsugaike.access: Bus from Hakuba or Otari. About 20 min north of Happo.

iwatake.character: Sunny Hakuba face with a gondola and mixed family terrain.
iwatake.access: Short bus from Hakuba Station. Next to Happo across the valley floor.

nozawa-onsen.hours: About 8:00–16:30; night skiing on selected runs
nozawa-onsen.character: Village skiing above a historic onsen town. Strong snow and gates.
nozawa-onsen.access: Shinkansen to Iiyama plus bus (~30 min), or Nagano plus bus (~1 hr 10 min).

shiga-kogen.character: Japan’s largest linked ski area; high elevation and a long season.
shiga-kogen.access: Shinkansen to Nagano plus bus to Yamanouchi / Shiga (~1 hr).

madarao.character: Tree-skiing specialist on the Iiyama side, 100% natural snow.
madarao.access: Shinkansen to Iiyama plus taxi or bus. Car is simplest in a storm.

akakura-onsen.character: Myoko powder above an onsen village; gates and trees.
akakura-onsen.access: Shinkansen to Joetsu-Myoko plus bus (~30 min).

suginohara.character: Long Myoko fall line and a big gondola; quieter than Akakura village.
suginohara.access: About 15 min from Akakura by car. Joetsu-Myoko plus bus or taxi.

kawaba.hours: Day plus night skiing (check official hours)
kawaba.character: Tokyo-side Gunma hill with a gondola and a strong night scene.
kawaba.access: About 2.5 hr from Tokyo by car. Bus from Jomo-Kogen (Joetsu Shinkansen).

kusatsu-onsen.character: Ski above Japan’s famous onsen town; compact and beginner-friendly.
kusatsu-onsen.access: Limited express or bus from Naganohara-Kusatsuguchi. About 3 hr from Tokyo.

tanigawadake.character: Ropeway-served alpine snowfield. Weather-dependent; gates and touring.
tanigawadake.access: Joetsu Shinkansen to Jomo-Kogen or Minakami plus bus to the ropeway.

fujiten.hours: Day plus night skiing (check official hours)
fujiten.character: Fuji-side day trip from Tokyo. Compact, views of the volcano when clear.
fujiten.access: About 2 hr from Tokyo by car via the Chuo. Bus from Kawaguchiko / Fuji-area stations.
